lines.en: label ramen10:
scene tsuneyokaori1
I walk into the ramen shop to be met with an...unusual sight.
lines.zh: 我走进拉面店，迎面撞见的是……不寻常的一幕。

lines.en: It’s by no means uncommon to see other people here at this time of night. In fact, Tojo Ramen is actually surprisingly popular given its size and location.
lines.zh: 这个点在这儿看到别人，其实一点都不稀奇。事实上，以 Tojo Ramen 的规模和位置来说，它受欢迎得令人意外。

lines.en: But...I can’t really say I expected to see {i}Kaori{/i} of all people here. Let alone a particularly angry looking Kaori.
lines.zh: 可是……我真没料到会在这儿见到 {i}Kaori{/i}——偏偏是她。更别说还是一个看起来格外生气的 Kaori。

lines.en: Isn’t she normally working around this time?
lines.zh: 这个时间她不是通常都在上班吗？

lines.en: Just how many places can she be at once?
lines.zh: 她到底能同时在多少个地方？

lines.en: : Why will you not listen to my proposal?! Do your human ears not function?! Is the spider to blame?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么不肯听我的提议？！你们人类的耳朵不好使吗？！是蜘蛛干的吗？！

lines.en: : We are not hiring, but thank you for your interest in Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 我们不招人，谢谢你对 Tojo Ramen 感兴趣。

lines.en: : Please do not come here anymore.
lines.zh: : 请不要再来了。

lines.en: : May I at least speak with the human who owns this noodle building?!
lines.zh: : 那我至少能和拥有这栋面楼的人类说句话吧？！

lines.en: : He is sick and bedridden. He can barely speak.
lines.zh: : 他卧病在床。话都说不太清。

lines.en: : He does not need to speak! He just needs to listen!
lines.zh: : 他不需要说话！他只需要听！

lines.en: : Is there a problem here?...
lines.zh: : 这儿出什么事了吗？……

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori2
: Oh. Hello again.
lines.zh: : 哦。又见面了。

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 请慢慢看菜单，有什么问题随时问我。

lines.en: if kaoridate1 == True:
: Friend?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 朋友？！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: else:
: Hamburger Man?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 汉堡人？！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Do you two know each other?
lines.zh: : 你们两个认识？

lines.en: : We do. In fact, I feel like I run into her pretty much everywhere I go.
lines.zh: : 认识。事实上，我走到哪儿都差不多能碰上她。

lines.en: : Do you know how to make her go away?
lines.zh: : 那你知道怎么让她走吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori3
: I have not yet even swallowed a single dough string!
lines.zh: : 我连一根面团条都还没吞下去呢！

lines.en: : She keeps calling my precious noodles dough strings.
lines.zh: : 她一直把我珍贵的面条叫成面团条。

lines.en: : I am tempted to slap a bitch.
lines.zh: : 我很想扇人一巴掌。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori4
I move several steps closer to the two of them and take a seat at the counter next to Kaori.
lines.zh: 我往前挪了几步，在 Kaori 旁边的吧台位坐下。

lines.en: : I see you learned another new phrase.
lines.zh: : 看来你又学了个新词。

lines.en: : Be quiet or I will slap you as well.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，不然我连你一起扇。

lines.en: : My fury can not be quelled.
lines.zh: : 我的怒火平息不了。

lines.en: : Well at least you aren’t hiding a knife behind your back this time.
lines.zh: : 至少这次你没把刀藏在身后。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori5
: Tsuneyo, don’t even think about it. Remember the tag line.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，想都别想。记住宣传语。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori4
: Tojo Ramen. All of the flavor, none of the violence.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen。风味俱全，零暴力。

lines.en: : There you go. I knew you had it in you.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。我就知道你做得到。

lines.en: : All I have in me is rage.
lines.zh: : 我体内只有愤怒。

lines.en: : And-
lines.zh: : 还有——

lines.en: : And noodles. Yes, I know.
lines.zh: : 还有面。对，我知道。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori6
: Make her hire me! Please!
lines.zh: : 让她雇我！求你了！

lines.en: : Why? You have like seven jobs already.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你已经差不多有七份工作了。

lines.en: : That is not even enough jobs to cover every day of the week!
lines.zh: : 那还不够覆盖一周的每一天！

lines.en: : ...Yes it is?
lines.zh: : ……够了吧？

lines.en: : I require additional occupations!
lines.zh: : 我需要更多的职业！

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori4
: Hey, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori7
: Ah-
: Will you give Kaori a job?
lines.zh: : 你能给 Kaori 一份工作吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori4
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori6
: I have exhausted every possible effort.
lines.zh: : 我已经用尽一切可能的努力了。

lines.en: : It looks like you’ll just need to find another job elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 看来你只能去别处再找一份工作了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori8
: I will not forget this betrayal.
lines.zh: : 我不会忘记这次背叛的。

lines.en: : Just be quiet and eat your dough-strings.
lines.zh: : 安静点，吃你的面团条。

lines.en: : You bastard. You will pay.
lines.zh: : 你这混蛋。你会付出代价的。

lines.en: : You are both fortunate that my stomach is lonely and has not absorbed hot pork liquid in a very long time.
lines.zh: : 你们两个该庆幸我的胃很寂寞，而且已经很久没有吸收过热猪肉汤汁了。

lines.en: : That's it. I’m calling the police.
lines.zh: : 够了。我要报警了。

lines.en: : No one is calling the police.
lines.zh: : 谁都不许报警。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori4
: Tsuneyo, why don’t you take a break for a little while and sit with the two of us?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你为什么不休息一会儿，跟我俩坐坐？

lines.en: : I am working.
lines.zh: : 我在工作。

lines.en: : Right. Which is exactly why I said “Take a break.”
lines.zh: : 对。所以我才说「休息一下」。

lines.en: : But you haven’t ordered anything yet. I will not be able to provide adequate service if you decide to do so while I am on the break you suggested.
lines.zh: : 可你还没点单呢。如果你在我休息的时候点单，我就没法提供周到的服务了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I'm not really hungry anyway. I just came here to talk to you for a bit.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我也不太饿。我只是来跟你说说话。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori9
: Do not fall for his trap! This man sells girls your age on the black market!
lines.zh: : 别上他的当！这个男人在黑市上卖你们这个年纪的女孩！

lines.en: : Kaori, stop going on about that human trafficking thing. I told you it wasn’t true.
lines.zh: : Kaori，别再提什么人口贩卖了。我跟你说了那不是真的。

lines.en: : No! I am very mad at you!
lines.zh: : 不！我还在生你的气！

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori10
: After all we’ve been through...you want to sell me?
lines.zh: : 我们经历了那么多……你还想把我卖了？

lines.en: : Of course I don’t want to sell you...
lines.zh: : 我当然不想卖你……

lines.en: : Do you really believe this suspicious character over me?
lines.zh: : 你真的宁愿相信这个可疑家伙，也不信我？

lines.en: : I don’t know what to believe. Everyone is calling my noodles dough strings and it is pushing my mind into turmoil.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该信什么。所有人都把我的面条叫成面团条，这让我心乱如麻。

lines.en: : Then how about you just take a seat and eat some noodles? That always helps, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那你干脆坐下来吃点面？那总能让你好受点，不是吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori11
: Ahh...noodles.
: There you go. Doesn’t that calm you down?
lines.zh: : 这就对了。是不是冷静下来了？

lines.en: : It does.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I am very easily swayed.
lines.zh: : 我很容易被说动。

lines.en: : I’ll try to forget that when my motives become slightly more inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 等我的动机变得稍微不那么正经的时候，我会尽量忘了这点的。

lines.en: : Noodles...
scene tsuneyokaori12
: What is this sorcery? All you did was tell her to think of dough strings and it is as if she's journeyed to another world.
lines.zh: : 这是什么法术？你只不过让她想想面团条，她就好像灵魂出窍去了另一个世界。

lines.en: : It’s not sorcery. I’ve just learned how to talk to her.
lines.zh: : 这不是法术。我只是学会了怎么跟她说话。

lines.en: : Noodles...
: That’s right, Tsuneyo. Noodles.
lines.zh: : 对，Tsuneyo。面。

lines.en: : Maybe I {i}will{/i} take a break...
lines.zh: : 也许我{i}真的{/i}该休息一下……

lines.en: : Just for a bit.
lines.zh: : 就一会儿。

lines.en: Tsuneyo begins to make herself a bowl of ramen and appears to completely forget Kaori's existence for the time being.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 开始给自己做一碗拉面，看起来暂时把 Kaori 的存在忘得一干二净。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori13
: Why will you not partake in the consumption of a bowl of pork warmth?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不吃一碗猪肉暖汤？

lines.en: : Is it because you only eat hamburgers?
lines.zh: : 是因为你只吃汉堡吗？

lines.en: : No, Kaori. I’m just not hungry.
lines.zh: : 不是，Kaori。我就是不饿。

lines.en: if kaoridate1 == True:
scene tsuneyokaori14
: Well, you may share mine if you change your mind.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你要是改变主意，可以分我的。

lines.en: : I am no longer mad at you. And we are friends now, so it is okay.
lines.zh: : 我不再生你的气了。我们现在是朋友，所以没关系。

lines.en: : Thank you, Kaori. That’s...very sweet of you. I’m really okay, though.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Kaori。这……你真贴心。不过我真的不用。

lines.en: : You should consume more carbohydrates so you can run longer distances.
lines.zh: : 你应该多摄入碳水化合物，这样能跑更远。

lines.en: : That’s...not a thing I want to do.
lines.zh: : 这……不是我想做的事。

lines.en: : Share my dough strings. I can not finish them all.
lines.zh: : 分我的面团条吧。我吃不完。

lines.en: else:
: Is it because you think the dough strings look like worms?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为你觉得面团条长得像虫子？

lines.en: : I also think they look like worms. But I will gladly consume them and become stronger.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得像虫子。但我会高高兴兴地吃掉它们，然后变强。

lines.en: : You do that.
lines.zh: : 你开心就好。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori15
: I have returned.
lines.zh: : 我回来了。

lines.en: Tsuneyo plops a bowl of ramen onto the counter that is so large that I can feel the wood slant down a few centimeters due to the sudden increase in weight.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把一碗拉面咚地放到吧台上，碗大到我能感觉到木头因为这突然增加的重量下沉了几厘米。

lines.en: : Can you really eat all of that?...
lines.zh: : 你真吃得下那么多吗？……

lines.en: : Any less than this would not quiet the rage burning within me.
lines.zh: : 比这少的量，压不住我体内燃烧的怒火。

lines.en: : You’re certainly fierce when you’re angry.
lines.zh: : 你生起气来可真凶。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, just because you know that isn’t a curse anymore doesn’t mean that it’s okay to say it to your friends.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，就算你知道那不再是脏话了，也不代表可以对朋友说。

lines.en: : You're not my friend. You aren't anything to me.
lines.zh: : 你不是我的朋友。你对我来说什么都不是。

lines.en: : What happened to that “After all we’ve been through” stuff from a few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 几分钟前那句「我们经历了那么多」去哪儿了？

lines.en: : I meant through all of the transactions. There have been several now.
lines.zh: : 我指的是那么多次交易。已经好几次了。

lines.en: if kaoridate1 == True:
: Friend.
lines.zh: : 朋友。

lines.en: else:
: Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 汉堡人。

lines.en: : Yes, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Kaori？

lines.en: : You seem quite capable of holding conversations with strange individuals.
lines.zh: : 你好像很擅长跟奇怪的人聊天。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re talking about yourself or Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你说的是她还是你自己。

lines.en: : I’m a perfectly normal, noodle-loving girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个再正常不过、热爱面条的女孩。

lines.en: : Do you see? Is she not strange?
lines.zh: : 你看到了吧？她不奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps it is for the best that I am not allowed to work in this building.
lines.zh: : 也许不让我在这栋楼里工作反而是好事。

lines.en: : I like other foods too much anyway. Like bratwurst! Or soda!
lines.zh: : 反正我也更喜欢别的食物。比如德式香肠！或者苏打水！

lines.en: : Soda isn’t a food, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 苏打水不是食物，Kaori。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori16
: Do not tell me how to live my life when you love {i}nothing{/i}.
lines.zh: : 一个{i}什么都不爱{/i}的人，别来教我怎么活。

lines.en: : Go on, Sensei. Tell her you love noodles.
lines.zh: : 说啊，Sensei。告诉她你爱面条。

lines.en: : Make me proud.
lines.zh: : 让我骄傲一下。

lines.en: : Noodles are good, don’t get me wrong, but I don’t think I’d put them at the top of my list.
lines.zh: : 面条是好吃，别误会，但我不会把它排在最前面。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori17
: You will regret these words.
lines.zh: : 你会后悔说这些话的。

lines.en: : Okay, why do you both look like you’re about to kill me? I don't like this.
lines.zh: : 好啦，你们俩干嘛一副要杀了我的样子？我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Is this what “leading someone on” means? I read about this in a book once.
lines.zh: : 这就是「吊着别人」的意思吗？我在书里读到过。

lines.en: : If these so-called “noodles” are not included in your favorite human items, what are?
lines.zh: : 如果这些所谓的「面条」不在你最喜欢的人类物品之列，那什么在？

lines.en: : Is there nothing you find sacred in this world?
lines.zh: : 这世上难道没有你觉得神圣的东西吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori18
: List the things you love!
lines.zh: : 把你爱的东西列出来！

lines.en: The things I love, huh?
lines.zh: 我爱的东西，是吧？

lines.en: Well, we’ve already crossed off noodles. So that leaves what?
lines.zh: 嗯，面条已经划掉了。那还剩什么？

lines.en: I don’t love my job.
lines.zh: 我不爱我的工作。

lines.en: I don’t love Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我不爱 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: I care a lot for some, if not all, of the girls I’ve met here...but is it really fair to call something as trivial as that {i}love?{/i}
lines.zh: 我在这里遇到的一些——如果不是全部——女孩，我很在乎她们……可把这么微不足道的东西叫成「{i}爱{/i}」，真的合适吗？

lines.en: Even with everything I’ve gone through, I still feel like some sort of outsider when I’m told to list the things that are important to me.
lines.zh: 即使经历了这一切，当别人要我列出对我重要的东西时，我依然觉得自己像个外人。

lines.en: In fact, there are so few of them that there's really no point in making a list at all.
lines.zh: 事实上，它们少得可怜，根本没必要列清单。

lines.en: : To be honest...I don’t think I love anything.
lines.zh: : 老实说……我觉得我什么都不爱。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori19
: Nothing?...
lines.zh: : 什么都没有？……

lines.en: : That’s good. It means there is still room in your heart to accept the one true savior.
lines.zh: : 那很好。这说明你心里还有空间，去接纳唯一的真救世主。

lines.en: : If you tell me that savior is noodles, I’m going to walk out of this restaurant right now.
lines.zh: : 如果你告诉我那个救世主是面条，我现在就走出这家店。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is best if I keep my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 也许我还是闭嘴比较好。

lines.en: : You did not name a single furry creature in your list of beloved items.
lines.zh: : 你列的喜爱物品里，一个毛茸茸的生物都没有。

lines.en: : You aren’t human at all, are you?
lines.zh: : 你根本不是人类，对吧？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t we be the ones asking {i}you{/i} that?
lines.zh: : 这话不该我们问{i}你{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’m the most human person here. Neither of you voiced how you feel about animals. Humans are supposed to like animals.
lines.zh: : 这里最像人类的就是我。你们俩都没说对动物有什么感觉。人类本该喜欢动物。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo loves animals.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 喜欢动物。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢吗？

lines.en: : For the sake of this conversation, yes.
lines.zh: : 为了让这段对话进行下去，是的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : I, Tsuneyo Tojo, love animals. Let this fact be known.
lines.zh: : 我，Tsuneyo Tojo，喜欢动物。让这个事实昭告天下。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori20
: At least you are not completely lost to the darkness, Pork Woman. There is hope for you yet.
lines.zh: : 至少你还没有彻底坠入黑暗，猪肉女。你还有救。

lines.en: : Pork Woman?
lines.zh: : 猪肉女？

lines.en: if kaoridate1 == True:
: That’s going to be your new nickname from now on. I can’t even remember how long I was stuck with Hamburger Man for.
lines.zh: : 从现在起这就是你的新外号了。我都记不清我被叫汉堡人多久了。

lines.en: else:
: That’s going to be your new nickname from now on. I can’t even remember how long I’ve been Hamburger Man now.
lines.zh: : 从现在起这就是你的新外号了。我都不记得自己当汉堡人多久了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori21
: I don’t know how to feel about this.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么想。

lines.en: : I’ve found that it’s just best to let it happen.
lines.zh: : 我发现最好的办法就是随它去。

lines.en: : You should have let me stab her when I had the chance.
lines.zh: : 你当初就该让我捅她一刀的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori22
: I take back all of the mean things I said to you. I require your protection.
lines.zh: : 我收回对你说过的所有难听话。我需要你的保护。

lines.en: : I have consumed too many dough-strings to be able to properly engage in combat with a girl as shapely and athletic and beautiful as her.
lines.zh: : 我吃了太多面团条，没法跟她这样身材好、又矫健又漂亮的女孩好好打一架。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori23
: Thank you. I think you are beautiful as well.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我也觉得你很漂亮。

lines.en: : Apology accepted.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori22
: Kaori, that’s not the proper response to “Thank you.”
lines.zh: : Kaori，这不是回应「谢谢」的正确方式。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori24
: Your instructions are too vague! I can not correct myself if all you say is that I am wrong and do not provide a correct answer!
lines.zh: : 你的指示太含糊了！如果你只说我不对、又不给正确答案，我怎么改正！

lines.en: : Just say “You’re welcome.”
lines.zh: : 就说「不客气」。

lines.en: : Welcome where?!
lines.zh: : 客气什么？！

lines.en: : Nowhere. It’s just a phrase.
lines.zh: : 没有客什么。这只是个说法。

lines.en: : Welcome is a greeting! You are trying to trick me, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 欢迎是打招呼！你想耍我，对吧？！

lines.en: : I will not fall for this! I will not be a pawn in your game!
lines.zh: : 我不会上当的！我不会当你棋局里的棋子！

lines.en: : I am Kaori Kadowaki! The Queen of Spiders! The Mistress of the Dark!
lines.zh: : 我是 Kaori Kadowaki！蜘蛛女王！黑暗的女主人！

lines.en: : And I am Tsuneyo Tojo, the quirky and fun-loving Flavor Samurai.
lines.zh: : 我是 Tsuneyo Tojo，古灵精怪、热爱欢乐的风味武士。

lines.en: : You two should join forces and create the strangest crime fighting duo of all time.
lines.zh: : 你俩应该联手，组成史上最古怪的打击犯罪二人组。

lines.en: : As long as I’m home before the moon comes out.
lines.zh: : 只要我能在月亮出来前回家就行。

lines.en: : That should be doable. Kaori works like eighteen jobs but you guys can probably find a time that’s good for both of you.
lines.zh: : 那应该没问题。Kaori 打十八份工，不过你们大概能找到两个人都合适的时间。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori25
: What do you think you’re doing? I will not agree to work with someone who would not agree to work with {i}me{/i} under different circumstances.
lines.zh: : 你以为你在干什么？我不会同意跟一个在别的情况下不肯跟{i}我{/i}共事的人合作。

lines.en: : I was born to serve customers, not justice.
lines.zh: : 我生来是服务顾客的，不是服务正义的。

lines.en: : I was born to serve-
lines.zh: : 我生来是服务——

lines.en: : Noodles. We know, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 面的。我们知道，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori26
: Ah-
: I’ve become predictable.
lines.zh: : 我变得好猜了。

lines.en: : You’ve been predictable since our second meeting.
lines.zh: : 从我们第二次见面起你就很好猜了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori25
: Whatever you say, bro.
lines.zh: : 随你说吧，兄弟。

lines.en: : Many years, I have lived. 154 Dog years to be exact. But never in my life have I been so out of place in one restaurant.
lines.zh: : 我活了很多年。确切地说，154 个狗年。可我这辈子从没在一家餐馆里这么格格不入过。

lines.en: : This side of town is pure evil.
lines.zh: : 这一带就是纯粹的邪恶。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori27
: I can feel it...deep inside of me- my organs wrapping around themselves.
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到……在我身体深处——我的内脏在互相缠绕。

lines.en: : I should have thanked them more than once.
lines.zh: : 我应该多谢她们几次的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori28
: I must go!
lines.zh: : 我必须走了！

lines.en: : Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: : Good day, humans!
lines.zh: : 再会了，人类们！

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori29
Kaori quickly disappears out of the ramen shop, slamming the door behind her.
lines.zh: Kaori 飞快地冲出拉面店，砰地摔上身后的门。

lines.en: I wonder where she-
lines.zh: 我想知道她——

lines.en: : The...
: The ramen...
lines.zh: : 这碗拉面……

lines.en: : It is nearly untouched...
lines.zh: : 几乎没动过……

lines.en: : Who...
: Who could do such a thing?...
lines.zh: : 谁能干出这种事？……

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori30
: Ugh, okay. Fine. I’ll eat it.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧。行。我吃。

lines.en: : I should have figured something like this was going to happen anyway.
lines.zh: : 我早该猜到会发生这种事的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyokaori31
: Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : It appears that I will be able to sleep tonight after all.
lines.zh: : 看来我今晚总算能睡得着了。

lines.en: scene black
I scarf down the ramen as quickly as I can and decide to head back before it gets too late.
lines.zh: 我尽快把拉面扒完，决定趁天色不太晚回去。

lines.en: The walk home is surprisingly quiet.
lines.zh: 回家路上出奇地安静。

lines.en: I get lost along the way.
lines.zh: 我中途迷路了。

lines.en: I should pay closer attention when moving around in the dark.
lines.zh: 在黑暗里走动，我该更留神些。

lines.zh: {i}Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
